video_url.title: YouTube Video URL
video_url.description: Valid YouTube video or VOD URL (e.g., https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=..., https://youtu.be/...). The Actor will analyze this video to find the most engaging highlight moments.

max_clips.title: Maximum Clips
max_clips.description: Number of top highlight segments to return, sorted by engagement score. Each clip is between 20-60 seconds, optimized for YouTube Shorts format.
